description: This file is a header for the dumpstate component of Android's bugreport system, defining classes, functions, and structures for generating and managing bug reports, including progress tracking, zip file handling, and system data collection.

classes.name: DurationReporter
classes.description: Helper class to measure and report the duration of code sections.

classes.name: Progress
classes.description: Tracks and persists progress estimation for bugreport generation.

classes.name: Dumpstate
classes.description: Main class orchestrating bugreport creation, data collection, and zip file management.

classes.name: DumpData
classes.description: Structure holding information about open dump files.

classes.name: ConsentCallback
classes.description: Handles user consent for sharing bug reports.

methods.name: RunCommand
methods.description: Executes a system command and waits for completion.

methods.name: RunDumpsys
methods.description: Runs dumpsys with specified arguments and timeout.

methods.name: DumpFile
methods.description: Outputs the contents of a file.

methods.name: AddZipEntry
methods.description: Adds a file to the zip archive.

methods.name: AddZipEntryFromFd
methods.description: Adds an entry to zip from a file descriptor.

methods.name: AddTextZipEntry
methods.description: Adds a text entry to zip.

methods.name: TakeScreenshot
methods.description: Captures a screenshot to a specified path.

methods.name: FinishZipFile
methods.description: Finalizes and closes the zip archive.

methods.name: CurrentVersionSupportsPriorityDumps
methods.description: Checks if current version supports priority dumps.

methods.name: Run
methods.description: Main entry point to generate bugreport.

methods.name: ParseCommandlineAndRun
methods.description: Parses CLI args and runs bugreport.
